actions.label: 󰖩  Wi-Fi
actions.command: sh -c 'if [ "$SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE" = true ]; then nmcli radio wifi on; else nmcli radio wifi off; fi'
actions.update-command: sh -c 'if [ "$(nmcli radio wifi)" = enabled ]; then echo true; else echo false; fi'

actions.label: 󰂯  Bluetooth
actions.command: sh -c 'if [ "$SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE" = true ]; then rfkill unblock bluetooth; sleep 1; bluetoothctl power on; else bluetoothctl power off; rfkill block bluetooth; fi'
actions.update-command: sh -c 'if bluetoothctl show 2>/dev/null | grep -q "Powered: yes"; then echo true; else echo false; fi'

actions.label: 󰍬  Microphone
actions.command: sh -c 'if [ "$SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE" = true ]; then wpctl set-mute @DEFAULT_AUDIO_SOURCE@ 0; else wpctl set-mute @DEFAULT_AUDIO_SOURCE@ 1; fi'
actions.update-command: sh -c 'if ! wpctl get-volume @DEFAULT_AUDIO_SOURCE@ | grep -q MUTED; then echo true; else echo false; fi'

actions.label: 󰖔  Night light
actions.command: sh -c 'if [ "$SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE" = true ]; then ~/.local/bin/lennox-nightlight on; else ~/.local/bin/lennox-nightlight off; fi'
actions.update-command: sh -c 'if [ "$(~/.local/bin/lennox-nightlight status)" = on ]; then echo true; else echo false; fi'

actions.label: 󰊗  Game mode
actions.command: sh -c 'if [ "$SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE" = true ]; then ~/.local/bin/lennox-mode game on; else ~/.local/bin/lennox-mode game off; fi'
actions.update-command: sh -c 'if [ "$(~/.local/bin/lennox-mode game status)" = on ]; then echo true; else echo false; fi'

actions.label: 󰅶  Stay awake
actions.command: sh -c 'if [ "$SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE" = true ]; then ~/.local/bin/lennox-idle off; else ~/.local/bin/lennox-idle on; fi'
actions.update-command: sh -c 'if [ "$(~/.local/bin/lennox-idle status)" = off ]; then echo true; else echo false; fi'

actions.label: 󰌪  Battery saver
actions.command: sh -c 'if [ "$SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE" = true ]; then powerprofilesctl set power-saver; else powerprofilesctl set balanced; fi'
actions.update-command: sh -c 'if [ "$(powerprofilesctl get)" = power-saver ]; then echo true; else echo false; fi'

actions.label: 󰔎  Dark mode
actions.command: sh -c 'if [ "$SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE" = true ]; then ~/.local/bin/lennox-theme dark; else ~/.local/bin/lennox-theme light; fi'
actions.update-command: sh -c 'if [ "$(~/.local/bin/lennox-get appearance.color_mode)" = dark ]; then echo true; else echo false; fi'
